main.description: Describe a space: its identity and current policy. Requires an OAuth read_self grant or a space credential; implemented by a space host.

space.description: Permissioned space URI, in the form at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Not a standard at-uri.
Permissioned space URI, in the form at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Not a standard at-uri.

uri.description: Deprecated; backwards compatibility only. The same value as space, under the name an older version of the atproto spaces specification used for this field (renamed to space on 2026-11-04). Sent for clients written against that version; current clients should read space.

policy.description: The space's current policy object. Open union; space policies other than the baseline set supply their own types.
